verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents continuous queries (SQL statements that run continuously to analyze streaming data in real time) and Dataform for declarative, version-controlled ELT pipelines, plus streaming ingestion via the Storage Write API and Pub/Sub subscriptions for near-real-time loading. Together these give data engineers continuous/incremental transformation capabilities natively in the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of continuous queries or Dataform pipelines in production, and detail on orchestration/scheduling maturity comparable to dedicated task schedulers.
